summary: A realtime 4v2 on Eclipsed: four seats of ours in the north-east (three Armada, one Cortex; Opus 5.5 medium players on Jev 1.13 under an Opus 5.5 high commander) against thebluegecko and u6bkep, both Armada, in the west. Our first soldiers stood near his start by 2:35-3:02 and the side led about 3,600 to 330 seen at 5:00, but the commander's gathering place meet_d5 lay under his D4 Beamer beside his Pawns, the seats arrived one at a time (6:12-7:23), and the body built by transfer at 8:15 walked into the same C4-D6 nest twice more (9:08-9:33, 11:04-13:10), the second time into his first Welders and a Pit Bull. All the while the side's extractors stood at 29-32 from 8:00 to the end (income about 62) and no tier 2 stood until t4's advanced vehicle plant at 17:20, after four failed placements, against his Welders from 11:10 and a moho at 12:35. After 'The lead is gone' (commander, 14:15) his Stout block killed t4's commander (14:52), a forward Pit Bull post at F6 and 15-16 Welders pinned t3's 10k body at H6-H7, and Liche atomic bombers from an air plant never scouted killed two more commanders at 21:28 and 21:35; the record ends at 21:45.

root.what: The commander spent the early lead (side army 3,604 against 330 seen at 5:00) by gathering four seats' raiders at meet_d5 (3000,4100), inside the reach of his D4 Beamer and beside his Pawns at C4/C5, with no lever for one seat's group to wait for another's (the transfer that existed was first used at 8:15). Each seat met him alone and was worn down. It was the first of three walks into the C4-D6 turret nest that spent the lead while the economy stood still. This is the reader's reading; no person commented, and the commander's own notes at 8:15 and 14:15 say the same.

their_play: Both Armada, one apparently on bots (Pawns, Centurions, then Welders and Butlers from an advanced bot lab) and one on vehicles (Stouts, Janus, a Rattlesnake); who played which is not in our records. A Beamer at D4 by about 3:40 and a bot lab at C8 seen at 4:40 (5 extractors, 6 solars). One commander walked out to E6/F7 and built a Beamer post at F7 with two constructors at 6:20 on the edge of our south, killing t3's constructor at 6:40. He held our raids under the D4 Beamer with 8-11 Pawns and a Centurion (6:45-7:07) and turned the C4-D6 ground into a turret nest (three Beamers, then an HLT at D5 by 13:26). Tier 2 came early: a Welder at D6 at 11:10, a moho and a Pit Bull at C6 by 12:35. Our body was traded down at D5/D6 (12:00-13:30). A block of 11-14 Stouts and 2-3 Janus pushed our north row (14:09-14:52), killed t5's spot_31 and t4's commander, and broke on t4's turrets. A forward Pit Bull post at F6 (16:16-16:21) with 7 Welders, 4 Butlers and an advanced constructor pinned our biggest body for five minutes under unseen fire, with a Rattlesnake at C4 shelling spot_31 (19:47) and 15-16 Welders at G5 (19:59). A B1 post (HLT, Beamer) held the north. Liche atomic bombers with radar planes came at 21:15 from an air plant we never saw and killed two commanders. The report's trade line at 20:15 read 32,869 of ours lost against 18,849 of his seen destroyed (unfinished-review.md); his seen losses reach about 25.6k by the end (analyze_match).

lens.existing_review: none: no review.md (the match's impedance-review.md and unfinished-review.md were read)
lens.caveats: There is no truth file: his economy, army and tier-2 clocks are floors from what we saw, and the people's own play is inferred from sightings. There is no ledger row, no results.jsonl and no review.md. The result is inferred from the record's end and the commanders' deaths. minutes.py, analyze_match.py, floor.py, raid_ledger.py and wake_read.py read only record-0/strategist-0, so I ran them on per-seat symlink views in the scratchpad (wake_read on seat 0 only). Per-seat armies include transferred units, so the per-seat windows mislead and the side's sums are the reading. 'His half' is measured from each seat's guessed start (B3, or C8 for t4). pro_baseline.py does not apply (not Comet Catcher). The impedance-review.md (2026-10-16) and unfinished-review.md (2026-10-17) in the match directory are model reviews of harness impedance and frames, not of the game. I build on their facts and differ in ranking: they put the cross-seat join first; I put the gathering place in his reach and the three walks into the nest, with the absent tier 2, as the game's root and cost.

How the game ended at 21:45: t2's commander was at 100% at H1 in the last sample. A Liche on it, or the host leaving?
Which person played the bots (Pawns, Welders) and which the vehicles (Stouts, Janus, Rattlesnake)? u6bkep played Armada vehicles on Center Command.
What was the unseen fire on t3's body at G6/F5 (18:40-19:25)? Cloaked snipers as t3 suspected, or the Pit Bull and Rattlesnake under radar?
